_note: RH Terminal defaults. Gates and flags are starting values, not results of a backtest like the DLMM spec: change them in ⚙ Settings (saved in data/settings.json) as you learn what works.

universe._maxLpFeePct: above this a pool is a honeypot rather than a fee tier (RH Pool: nothing real exists between 20% and 60%)

scan._maxPools: pools (by last hour's fees) that get DexScreener data; watchlist and open positions always do

gates._minFeePctDay: fees 24h / TVL per day (pool < 24h: over its own hours). preset dlmm: 2.74 (= 1000% APR)
gates._maxPriceChg1hPct: DLMM owner review Nov 2026: entering with price 1h <= +5% made +2.5% vs +0.4% above. null = off

flags._nightEntryLocalHours: DLMM found night entries worse on Solana; no RH data yet. [0, 9] turns the flag on (WIB)
flags._review2026_11: DLMM Nov 2026 review: pools < 6h lost the most to price; 24h vol/mcap above 3x was churn/dump. Its 0.3x floor would flag ~95% of RH pools (median 0.00x), so the RH preset only flags above 3x.

position._ladder: RH ladder (same as RH Pool): equal-width slices from rangeTopPct down to rangeBottomPct below the price, quote-only, weights 1:2:...:n (deepest slice biggest)

ping._sortBy: volMcapFit (24h vol/mcap inside 0.3-3x, DLMM default) | fee1hPct | fees1hUsd | volTvl1h | fee24hPct
ping._mode: new = one Telegram ping per pool when it newly enters PING | blast = one card with the top N every blastEveryMin

_filterPreset: rh = these values (fitted to RH pool data) | dlmm = DLMM Terminal's Solana numbers (settings.PRESETS); a value you set in ⚙ wins over either
